items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: And so I took a lesson with Bobby. And we’re good friends. And he adjudicated me when I was a kid.

ctx.x: Oh that’s very cute. I can just picture being, you know, like a lot of people I’ve done my share of adjudications at high school festivals. I can just picture that. Like gee that was a high note but are you sure you want him playing that?

Yeah that note doesn’t really work in that chord. But I’ve talked to Bobby Shew about this, because I just took a lesson with Bobby a few weeks ago. Because as I had gone through my cancer treatments and stuff, I’m still recovering in many ways, strength wise. And so I took a lesson with Bobby. And we’re good friends. And he adjudicated me when I was a kid. And so we joke about that a lot.
